digest.component_or_area: completion-verification close gate / agent step runner
propositions: tool-call loops in the verify step exhaust budget without producing a verdict, surfacing bare LLMError with diagnostic: null
the existing empty-filter rewrite for tool_step_limit causes Bedrock/Anthropic 400 errors when toolUse blocks exist in history
repetition detection requires a windowed distinct-ratio metric to distinguish k-cycles from healthy breadth, replacing the inverted adjacent metric
budget exhaustion in CompletionAgentStep.run must be caught and routed to bounded recovery with fresh per-criterion evidence instead of force-close
gate_error_v1 sidecars must durably surface repetition diagnostics (loop-vs-breadth counters) for operator actionability
usage recording including tool-calls, distinct ratio, and max_consecutive_repeat must be enabled by default to enable gate tuning
